prompt:
Create a square waist-up profile illustration of one adult human man of Dale, a rugged river trader and boatman. Use warm brown fine pen and pencil contours on pale ivory paper with moderate simplified hatching, like the recently simplified dwarf of Moria. Clear expressive outlines, grouped short hatch strokes only in shadow areas, generous unmarked paper highlights. About one third less fine detail than the earlier heavily textured riverfolk portrait. No dense skin texture or blanket shading.
Lean sturdy man about forty, weathered face, short wavy hair under a plain soft wool cap, close beard and moustache, alert quietly confident expression. Rolled-sleeve linen shirt, plain leather jerkin with one simple geometric stitched border, wool shoulder wrap, leather belt, small pouch and sheathed short sword. One natural hand loosely holds a coil of working rope at belt height. Rope drawn as clear simple twisted forms without microscopic fibers. Three-quarter view with centered readable face, ample headroom for profile cropping, torso and hand included. Hair in grouped locks, cheek and jaw with selective hatch marks; broad cloth areas pale with shadows only under folds. Medieval river traveler, no modern clothing. Blank nearly white cream paper background with a few faint hatch strokes behind shoulders. No scenery, other people, text, frame, watermark, smooth blended realistic shading, full color or thick cartoon outlines. Final square 640x640 profile.
